key: TAUBE: Ah, time to battle, is it?
en: TAUBE: Ah, time to battle, is it?
ja: タウベ: おお、バトルの時間ですかな?

key: TAUBE: Well I don't know if I can offer someone of your skill level a challenge.
en: TAUBE: Well I don't know if I can offer someone of your skill level a challenge.
ja: タウベ: あなたほどの腕前の方に、歯応えのある挑戦を提供できるかは分かりませんが。

key: But I hope we can both have fun!
en: But I hope we can both have fun!
ja: でも、お互い楽しめたらいいですね!

key: Take your position!
en: Take your position!
ja: 位置についてください!

key: TAUBE: I hope you don't mind, I'm rather partial to Double Battles.
en: TAUBE: I hope you don't mind, I'm rather partial to Double Battles.
ja: タウベ: よろしければ、私はダブルバトルの方が好きなのですが。

key: I find it is the best way that my Pokémon-- that my friends can really show off their teamwork!
en: I find it is the best way that my Pokémon-- that my friends can really show off their teamwork!
ja: 私のポケモン――いえ、友達たちが、連携の妙を存分に見せられる一番の方法だと思うのです!

key: Good luck, Champion of the Future!
en: Good luck, Champion of the Future!
ja: 未来のチャンピオン、幸運を!

key: Marvelous! I can feel your Pokémon's friendship!
en: Marvelous! I can feel your Pokémon's friendship!
ja: 素晴らしい! あなたのポケモンたちの友情を感じますよ!

key: TAUBE: Whew! You have quite the team; that was intense.
en: TAUBE: Whew! You have quite the team; that was intense.
ja: タウベ: ふう! なかなかのチームですね、白熱しました。

key: Even if we had a Pokémon League, I doubt I could ever challenge it-- these guys are the first six Pokémon I ever met.
en: Even if we had a Pokémon League, I doubt I could ever challenge it-- these guys are the first six Pokémon I ever met.
ja: 仮にポケモンリーグがあったとしても、私には挑戦できないでしょうね――この子たちは、私が初めて出会った6匹のポケモンなんです。

key: After making such good friends, I couldn't bring myself to battle with any others!
en: After making such good friends, I couldn't bring myself to battle with any others!
ja: こんなにいい友達ができてしまったら、他のポケモンとは戦う気になれなくて!

key: TAKA: Wow... I mean, even if you lost, that was amazing.
en: TAKA: Wow... I mean, even if you lost, that was amazing.
ja: タカ: すごい……その、負けたとしても、今のはすごかったよ。

key: You're an incredible trainer!
en: You're an incredible trainer!
ja: あなたはすごいトレーナーだね!

key: TAUBE: No, no. I don't think I'm particularly special--
en: TAUBE: No, no. I don't think I'm particularly special--
ja: タウベ: いやいや。私が特別だとは思っていません――

key: I just have amazing Pokémon.
en: I just have amazing Pokémon.
ja: ただ、素晴らしいポケモンに恵まれているだけです。

key: I've been with these guys since I was just a kid.
en: I've been with these guys since I was just a kid.
ja: 子供の頃からこの子たちと一緒にいるんです。

key: I couldn't be happier with them...
en: I couldn't be happier with them...
ja: これ以上ないくらい幸せですよ……

key: Ah, but I got so caught up! Let's head downstairs to check on Celebi!
en: Ah, but I got so caught up! Let's head downstairs to check on Celebi!
ja: ああ、つい夢中になってしまいましたね! 下に行ってセレビィの様子を見に行きましょう!

key: TAKA: He had a Chatot too...
en: TAKA: He had a Chatot too...
ja: タカ: あの人もペラップを持ってたんだ……

key: TAKA: When father gave me a Chatot egg, I just assumed he found it somewhere.
en: TAKA: When father gave me a Chatot egg, I just assumed he found it somewhere.
ja: タカ: 父さんがペラップのタマゴをくれた時、どこかで見つけたんだろうって思ってた。

key: Do you think he...
en: Do you think he...
ja: もしかして父さんは……

key: TAKA: Nevermind. Let's go downstairs.
en: TAKA: Nevermind. Let's go downstairs.
ja: タカ: いや、何でもない。下に行こう。

key: TAUBE: That is quite all right too.
en: TAUBE: That is quite all right too.
ja: タウベ: それはそれで、まったく構いませんよ。

key: There is no pressure, but of course I will be here should you change your mind.
en: There is no pressure, but of course I will be here should you change your mind.
ja: 無理にとは言いませんが、もちろん気が変わったらここにいますからね。

key: The future must be bright, with Trainers like you.
en: The future must be bright, with Trainers like you.
ja: あなたのようなトレーナーがいるなら、未来はきっと明るいでしょう。

key: I was never cut out for battling myself, truth be told.
en: I was never cut out for battling myself, truth be told.
ja: 正直に言うと、私自身はバトルにあまり向いていなかったんです。

key: I'm certainly nothing like Joseph.
en: I'm certainly nothing like Joseph.
ja: ジョゼフとは全然違いますからね。

key: Even young Elias has shown more of a spark for battle than me!
en: Even young Elias has shown more of a spark for battle than me!
ja: 若いイライアスの方が、私よりよほどバトルの才を見せていますよ!

key: ELIAS: You're being very humble, but that was an impressive showing, Father Taube.
en: ELIAS: You're being very humble, but that was an impressive showing, Father Taube.
ja: イライアス: ずいぶんとご謙遜されていますが、見事な戦いぶりでしたよ、タウベ神父。

key: You are a truly skilled trainer.
en: You are a truly skilled trainer.
ja: 本当に優れたトレーナーでいらっしゃいます。

key: My Pokémon are the special ones.
en: My Pokémon are the special ones.
ja: 特別なのは、私のポケモンたちの方です。

key: I'm just the guy that was lucky enough to befriend them.
en: I'm just the guy that was lucky enough to befriend them.
ja: 私はただ、運良くこの子たちと友達になれただけの人間ですよ。

key: I've been with these guys since I was just a kid, and couldn't be happier.
en: I've been with these guys since I was just a kid, and couldn't be happier.
ja: 子供の頃からこの子たちと一緒にいて、これ以上ないくらい幸せなんです。

key: ELIAS: Sirius and Lin...
en: ELIAS: Sirius and Lin...
ja: イライアス: シリウスとリン……

key: ELIAS: I didn't stop them taking control of the Order.
en: ELIAS: I didn't stop them taking control of the Order.
ja: イライアス: 私は、彼らが教団を掌握するのを止められなかった。

key: And because of my failure...
en: And because of my failure...
ja: そして私のこの失態のせいで……

key: The noble Alcantara family line has ended.
en: The noble Alcantara family line has ended.
ja: 高貴なアルカンタラ家の血筋は、途絶えてしまった。

key: ELIAS: I'm sorry, Taube. I'm sorry, Father.
en: ELIAS: I'm sorry, Taube. I'm sorry, Father.
ja: イライアス: すまない、タウベ。すまない、神父様。

key: I hope neither of you ever learn how much of a disappointment I turned out to be.
en: I hope neither of you ever learn how much of a disappointment I turned out to be.
ja: 私がどれほどの失望をもたらす存在になってしまったか、あなた方お二人には、決して知られたくない。

key: Celebi is thrashing about. It looks like it isn't in control.
en: Celebi is thrashing about. It looks like it isn't in control.
ja: セレビィが暴れている。自分を制御できていないようだ。

key: Perhaps more water will help?
en: Perhaps more water will help?
ja: もっと水をかければ、良くなるだろうか?

key: \PN gently poured a third bottle of water over the rampaging Pokémon.
en: \PN gently poured a third bottle of water over the rampaging Pokémon.
ja: \PNは、暴れるポケモンにそっと3本目の水をかけた。

key: The soaking wet Temporal Fragments lash out!
en: The soaking wet Temporal Fragments lash out!
ja: びしょぬれになった時の欠片が暴れ出す!

key: The Temporal Fragments lash out!
en: The Temporal Fragments lash out!
ja: 時の欠片が暴れ出す!

key: Biiiiii~!
en: Biiiiii~!
ja: ビイイィ~!

key: Celebi looks much healthier!
en: Celebi looks much healthier!
ja: セレビィは、だいぶ元気になったようだ!

key: It doesn't seem fully recovered yet, but it is in control and full of energy!
en: It doesn't seem fully recovered yet, but it is in control and full of energy!
ja: まだ完全に回復してはいないようだが、自分を制御できていて、元気いっぱいだ!

key: CELEBI: Biiiii!
en: CELEBI: Biiiii!
ja: セレビィ: ビイイィ!

key: TAKA: Great job as always, \PN.
en: TAKA: Great job as always, \PN.
ja: タカ: いつもすごいね、\PN。

key: You're a battling machine.
en: You're a battling machine.
ja: まさにバトルマシーンだよ。

key: TAUBE: Indeed, that was spectacular!
en: TAUBE: Indeed, that was spectacular!
ja: タウベ: 本当に、見事なものでした!

key: To think you could calm it down with just a good fight!
en: To think you could calm it down with just a good fight!
ja: いい勝負をするだけで落ち着かせられるとは、思いもしませんでしたよ!

key: TAKA: Wait, you're the one that said that would work!
en: TAKA: Wait, you're the one that said that would work!
ja: タカ: 待って、それが効くって言ったの、あなたじゃないですか!

key: TAUBE: That does sound like something I would say!
en: TAUBE: That does sound like something I would say!
ja: タウベ: 確かに、私が言いそうなことですね!

key: But I've also not slept in two days.
en: But I've also not slept in two days.
ja: でも、私、二日も寝ていないもので。

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: Well, uh, thanks again for helping us out so much Mr... Taube.
en: Well, uh, thanks again for helping us out so much Mr... Taube.
ja: その、えっと、色々手伝ってくれて本当にありがとう、タウベさん。

key: I guess now that it's a lot healthier, Celebi will take us home?
en: I guess now that it's a lot healthier, Celebi will take us home?
ja: だいぶ元気になったし、セレビィが僕らを家に連れて帰ってくれるってことでいいのかな?

key: TAUBE: I imagine so.
en: TAUBE: I imagine so.
ja: タウベ: そうだと思いますよ。

key: Although it's not at full strength-- so Celebi may need to rest a little on the way if it's a particularly big jump.
en: Although it's not at full strength-- so Celebi may need to rest a little on the way if it's a particularly big jump.
ja: もっとも万全ではないので、特に大きな跳躍だと、途中でセレビィが少し休む必要があるかもしれません。

key: I hope you can find a solution to fully healing it back in your time.
en: I hope you can find a solution to fully healing it back in your time.
ja: あなたの時代で、完全に癒す方法を見つけられることを願っています。

key: TAKA: You've already helped a lot.
en: TAKA: You've already helped a lot.
ja: タカ: もう十分、助けてもらったよ。

key: We're sorry to keep you from your newborn for so long.
en: We're sorry to keep you from your newborn for so long.
ja: 生まれたばかりの子から、こんなに長く引き離してしまってごめん。

key: TAUBE: Don't worry, it was my pleasure to aid such fine people, as well as helping out a legendary Pokémon.
en: TAUBE: Don't worry, it was my pleasure to aid such fine people, as well as helping out a legendary Pokémon.
ja: タウベ: ご心配なく、あなたたちのような立派な方々を、そして伝説のポケモンを助けられて光栄でしたよ。

key: Taking the time to help those in need...
en: Taking the time to help those in need...
ja: 困っている者のために時間を割くこと……

key: That's the kind of man I want my son to grow up to be, anyway.
en: That's the kind of man I want my son to grow up to be, anyway.
ja: それこそ、私が息子に育ってほしいと思う男の姿ですから。

key: If I can't do that myself, what example am I setting?
en: If I can't do that myself, what example am I setting?
ja: 自分でそれができなかったら、どんな手本を示していることになるでしょうか。

key: But of course, I am not worried.
en: But of course, I am not worried.
ja: でも、もちろん心配はしていません。

key: I have the most wonderful wife, and a whole region of honest, hardworking, and friendly people around us.
en: I have the most wonderful wife, and a whole region of honest, hardworking, and friendly people around us.
ja: 最高の妻がいますし、周りには正直で、勤勉で、親切な人たちの暮らすこの地方全体がありますから。

key: Lord Arceus smiles down upon my son.
en: Lord Arceus smiles down upon my son.
ja: アルセウス様も、息子に微笑んでくださっているでしょう。

key: I have every faith he will grow into a far better man than I could ever hope to be.
en: I have every faith he will grow into a far better man than I could ever hope to be.
ja: 私が望める以上に、はるかに立派な男に育ってくれると、心から信じています。

key: Why, I'm sure that however far in the future you are from, even if it is past the life of my son, his name lives on.
en: Why, I'm sure that however far in the future you are from, even if it is past the life of my son, his name lives on.
ja: なんと、あなた方がどれほど未来から来られたのだとしても、たとえ息子の人生よりも先の時代であっても、きっとその名は生き続けているはずです。

key: Phoenix will be the brightest star in the sky, guiding the region to a better future.
en: Phoenix will be the brightest star in the sky, guiding the region to a better future.
ja: フェニックスは、空で一番輝く星となり、この地方をより良い未来へと導いてくれるでしょう。

key: TAKA: I...
en: TAKA: I...
ja: タカ: 僕は……

key: TAUBE: No, no, don't tell me.
en: TAUBE: No, no, don't tell me.
ja: タウベ: いえ、いえ、言わないでください。

key: It's not my place to know the future.
en: It's not my place to know the future.
ja: 未来を知るのは、私の立場ではありませんから。

key: Guess it's time to go, \PN...
en: Guess it's time to go, \PN...
ja: もう行く時間みたいだね、\PN……

key: Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
en: Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
ja: セレビィは元気いっぱいで、出発する準備ができているようだ!

key: Do you want to travel through time again?
en: Do you want to travel through time again?
ja: もう一度、時を旅しますか?

key: You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
en: You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
ja: セレビィがあなたを時の中を運び、周囲の景色が再び薄れていくのを感じる!

key: Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
en: Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
ja: セレビィは少しじれったそうにしているが、あなたを待っていてくれる。

key: ELIAS: As expected, a spectacular showing.
en: ELIAS: As expected, a spectacular showing.
ja: イライアス: さすがです、見事な戦いぶりでした。

key: Your skill in battle is unmatched.
en: Your skill in battle is unmatched.
ja: その戦いの腕前、比類なきものですね。

key: TAUBE: Indeed, that was incredible!
en: TAUBE: Indeed, that was incredible!
ja: タウベ: 本当に、すごかったです!

key: ELIAS: Well of course-- after all, it was your idea, Father Taube.
en: ELIAS: Well of course-- after all, it was your idea, Father Taube.
ja: イライアス: それはそうでしょう――何しろ、あなたの発案だったのですから、タウベ神父。

key: TAUBE: Ah, it was, wasn't it?
en: TAUBE: Ah, it was, wasn't it?
ja: タウベ: ああ、そうでしたね?

key: Well, I am happy to see I was correct!
en: Well, I am happy to see I was correct!
ja: まあ、自分が正しかったと分かってうれしいですよ!

key: ELIAS: That's...
en: ELIAS: That's...
ja: イライアス: それは……

key: You spoke with such conviction before.
en: You spoke with such conviction before.
ja: 先ほどは、あれほど確信を持って話しておられたのに。

key: Surely you were confident in your idea?
en: Surely you were confident in your idea?
ja: ご自分の考えに、確かな自信をお持ちだったのでは?

key: TAUBE: Your faith in me is an honor.
en: TAUBE: Your faith in me is an honor.
ja: タウベ: あなたの信頼は、私にとって光栄なことです。

key: I hope my legacy in the future is deserving of faith.
en: I hope my legacy in the future is deserving of faith.
ja: 未来における私の遺産が、その信頼に値するものであることを願います。

key: However, my son was just born.
en: However, my son was just born.
ja: もっとも、息子が生まれたばかりでしてね。

key: I have not slept in two days.
en: I have not slept in two days.
ja: 二日間、眠っていないのです。

key: ELIAS: That is...
en: ELIAS: That is...
ja: イライアス: それは……

key: I see.
en: I see.
ja: なるほど。

key: Well, the point is that this has worked, and you have our deepest gratitude.
en: Well, the point is that this has worked, and you have our deepest gratitude.
ja: まあ、要点は、これがうまくいったということです。心からの感謝を申し上げます。

key: I suppose all that is left is for the two of us to return to our time.
en: I suppose all that is left is for the two of us to return to our time.
ja: あとは、私たち二人が自分たちの時代に戻るだけですね。

key: TAUBE: Indeed, it looks like Celebi has the energy to travel through time once more.
en: TAUBE: Indeed, it looks like Celebi has the energy to travel through time once more.
ja: タウベ: 確かに、セレビィにはもう一度時を旅するだけの力があるようです。

key: Although it's not at full strength, so it may need to rest a little on the way if it's a particularly big jump.
en: Although it's not at full strength, so it may need to rest a little on the way if it's a particularly big jump.
ja: もっとも万全ではないので、特に大きな跳躍であれば、途中で少し休む必要があるかもしれません。

key: ELIAS: It has been an honor and a pleasure, Father Taube.
en: ELIAS: It has been an honor and a pleasure, Father Taube.
ja: イライアス: 光栄で、喜ばしいひとときでした、タウベ神父。

key: Your help has been invaluable.
en: Your help has been invaluable.
ja: あなたの助けは、かけがえのないものでした。

key: I have no doubt we will find a way to fully heal Celebi thanks to you.
en: I have no doubt we will find a way to fully heal Celebi thanks to you.
ja: あなたのおかげで、セレビィを完全に癒す方法を必ず見つけられると確信しています。

key: And of course, we're sorry to have kept you from your newborn for so long.
en: And of course, we're sorry to have kept you from your newborn for so long.
ja: そしてもちろん、生まれたばかりのお子様からこんなに長く引き離してしまい、申し訳ありませんでした。

key: TAUBE: You flatter me.
en: TAUBE: You flatter me.
ja: タウベ: 買いかぶりすぎですよ。

key: It was my pleasure to aid two members of our Order from the future, not to mention a Legendary Pokémon!
en: It was my pleasure to aid two members of our Order from the future, not to mention a Legendary Pokémon!
ja: 未来から来た教団の同志お二人を、そして伝説のポケモンまでも助けられて、光栄でしたよ!

key: ELIAS: Phoenix Alcantara...
en: ELIAS: Phoenix Alcantara...
ja: イライアス: フェニックス・アルカンタラ……

key: ELIAS: ...
en: ELIAS: ...
ja: イライアス: ……

key: Well, we should be on our way, anyway.
en: Well, we should be on our way, anyway.
ja: さて、そろそろ出発しましょうか。

key: Thank you again, Father Taube.
en: Thank you again, Father Taube.
ja: 改めて、ありがとうございました、タウベ神父。

key: TAKA: If he's like this, why was Father so...
en: TAKA: If he's like this, why was Father so...
ja: タカ: あの人がこんな人なら、なんで父さんはあんなに……

key: Sorry, just thinking.
en: Sorry, just thinking.
ja: ごめん、ちょっと考えてただけ。

key: Good luck with the battle; I'm cheering for you.
en: Good luck with the battle; I'm cheering for you.
ja: バトル頑張って、応援してるよ。

key: I mean, mostly.
en: I mean, mostly.
ja: まあ、だいたいは、だけど。

key: I do wanna know if Father being so skilled was a fluke, or if the skill runs in the family and my lack of it is the fluke...
en: I do wanna know if Father being so skilled was a fluke, or if the skill runs in the family and my lack of it is the fluke...
ja: 父さんがあんなに上手いのがまぐれだったのか、それとも才能が家系に流れてて、僕にそれがないのがまぐれなのか、知りたいんだよね……

key: ELIAS: Friends...
en: ELIAS: Friends...
ja: イライアス: 友……

key: I was always his servant; nothing more.
en: I was always his servant; nothing more.
ja: 私は常に、彼の従者にすぎなかった。それ以上の何者でもない。

key: That's all I knew.
en: That's all I knew.
ja: それが、私が知る全てだった。

key: That's what the Order taught us.
en: That's what the Order taught us.
ja: それが、教団が私たちに教えたことだ。

key: ...Before you returned my sight, he cut my hair for me.
en: ...Before you returned my sight, he cut my hair for me.
ja: ……あなたが私の目を取り戻してくれる前、彼が私の髪を切ってくれた。

key: The Hazel family has a ceremonial haircut, but I was unable to do it myself without my sight.
en: The Hazel family has a ceremonial haircut, but I was unable to do it myself without my sight.
ja: ヘーゼル家には儀式的な散髪の習わしがあるが、視力がなくては自分ではできなかった。

key: He offered to do it for me.
en: He offered to do it for me.
ja: 彼は、代わりにやってくれると申し出た。

key: He was not very good at it, the cut was incredibly messy, but...
en: He was not very good at it, the cut was incredibly messy, but...
ja: あまり上手ではなくて、仕上がりはひどくめちゃくちゃだったが……

key: I keep my hair the way he did it even now, in his honor.
en: I keep my hair the way he did it even now, in his honor.
ja: 今でも、彼をしのんで、その髪型のままにしている。

key: Is that friendship?
en: Is that friendship?
ja: それが、友情なのだろうか?

key: TAKA: Oh.
en: TAKA: Oh.
ja: タカ: あ。

key: I'm here too.
en: I'm here too.
ja: 僕もここにいるよ。

key: That's not a good sign for how this is going to go.
en: That's not a good sign for how this is going to go.
ja: これ、この先どうなるかを考えると、あんまりいい兆候じゃないな。

key: ???: Oh, visitors?
en: ???: Oh, visitors?
ja: ???: おや、お客様ですか?

key: I'm very sorry, but I was just here to get some things, I can't give a sermon today.
en: I'm very sorry, but I was just here to get some things, I can't give a sermon today.
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、今日はちょっと物を取りに来ただけで、説教はできないんです。

key: But if you just need food, help yourself to the fruit downstairs!
en: But if you just need food, help yourself to the fruit downstairs!
ja: でも、食べ物が必要なだけなら、下にある果物をどうぞご自由に!

key: Our doors are always open, even if I am not present.
en: Our doors are always open, even if I am not present.
ja: 私がいなくても、この扉はいつでも開いていますから。

key: TAKA: Oh no, it's him...
en: TAKA: Oh no, it's him...
ja: タカ: うわ、あの人だ……

key: Uh, okay, remember: be polite, watch your manners...
en: Uh, okay, remember: be polite, watch your manners...
ja: えっと、いいか、覚えとけ、礼儀正しく、行儀よく……

key: He's gonna be a real stickler, just don't take it personally.
en: He's gonna be a real stickler, just don't take it personally.
ja: うるさく言われるだろうけど、気にしないでくれよな。

key: TAKA: Hello sir, we're uh...
en: TAKA: Hello sir, we're uh...
ja: タカ: こんにちは、僕たち、その……

key: We're very sorry to intrude as you were leaving.
en: We're very sorry to intrude as you were leaving.
ja: お出かけのところ、お邪魔してしまって本当にすみません。

key: However, we have a Pokémon that urgently needs medical attention, and...
en: However, we have a Pokémon that urgently needs medical attention, and...
ja: でも、緊急に治療が必要なポケモンがいて、それで……

key: ???: Well, that puts me in a bind.
en: ???: Well, that puts me in a bind.
ja: ???: それは、困りましたね。

key: I really must get home...
en: I really must get home...
ja: 本当に家に帰らなければならないのですが……

key: But bring it here; I'll do what I can.
en: But bring it here; I'll do what I can.
ja: でも、こちらへ連れてきなさい。できることをしましょう。

key: ???: Goodness. That Pokémon is dripping wet.
en: ???: Goodness. That Pokémon is dripping wet.
ja: ???: おやまあ。そのポケモン、びしょぬれですね。

key: Is it raining outside?
en: Is it raining outside?
ja: 外は雨でも降っているのですか?

key: I... Oh my.
en: I... Oh my.
ja: 私……おやおや。

key: That's a Celebi.
en: That's a Celebi.
ja: セレビィではありませんか。

key: This is... Well, it explains your clothes.
en: This is... Well, it explains your clothes.
ja: これは……ああ、あなた方の服装にも納得がいきますね。

key: Although some of it is a familiar style-- I have a scarf just like yours!
en: Although some of it is a familiar style-- I have a scarf just like yours!
ja: もっとも、見覚えのある形もありますが――あなたのと同じスカーフを、私も持っていますよ!

key: But where are my manners?
en: But where are my manners?
ja: おっと、これは失礼しました。

key: I am Taube Alcantara-- I oversee this temple.
en: I am Taube Alcantara-- I oversee this temple.
ja: 私はタウベ・アルカンタラ――この神殿を治める者です。

key: TAKA: You knowing about Celebi saves a lot of explaining.
en: TAKA: You knowing about Celebi saves a lot of explaining.
ja: タカ: セレビィのこと知ってるなら、説明の手間がだいぶ省けるな。

key: Oh, uh, this is \PN, they're the important one.
en: Oh, uh, this is \PN, they're the important one.
ja: あ、えっと、こっちは\PN、大事な方だよ。

key: I'm just kind of along for the ride.
en: I'm just kind of along for the ride.
ja: 僕はまあ、ただの付き添いってとこ。

key: Apparently.
en: Apparently.
ja: らしいけど。

key: TAUBE: Don't be like that!
en: TAUBE: Don't be like that!
ja: タウベ: そんなこと言わないでください!

key: Look at this Pokémon; it's barely got any energy left-- and yet it spent what little it had to bring you here along with your friend.
en: Look at this Pokémon; it's barely got any energy left-- and yet it spent what little it had to bring you here along with your friend.
ja: このポケモンを見てください、力がほとんど残っていないのに、それでもわずかに残った力を使って、あなたたち二人をここまで連れてきたんですよ。

key: I find Pokémon to be very smart, and this Celebi clearly believes in you.
en: I find Pokémon to be very smart, and this Celebi clearly believes in you.
ja: ポケモンはとても賢いものだと思っていますし、このセレビィは明らかにあなたのことを信じています。

key: So even when things seem dark and you can't have faith in yourself-- have faith in that Celebi.
en: So even when things seem dark and you can't have faith in yourself-- have faith in that Celebi.
ja: ですから、物事が暗く見えて自分を信じられないときは――そのセレビィを信じてください。

key: So, what's your name?
en: So, what's your name?
ja: それで、お名前は?

key: TAKA: Oh well... I'm Taka. It's uh, nice to meet you, sir.
en: TAKA: Oh well... I'm Taka. It's uh, nice to meet you, sir.
ja: タカ: あ、えっと……僕はタカです。その、はじめまして。

key: TAUBE: I told you, just call me Taube!
en: TAUBE: I told you, just call me Taube!
ja: タウベ: だから、タウベと呼んでくださいと言ったでしょう!

key: And Taka, that's a fine name.
en: And Taka, that's a fine name.
ja: それに、タカ、いい名前ですね。

key: If it had come to mind when my wife and I were debating baby names, perhaps we would've gone with that for our newborn.
en: If it had come to mind when my wife and I were debating baby names, perhaps we would've gone with that for our newborn.
ja: 妻と赤ちゃんの名前を話し合っていたとき、それが思い浮かんでいたら、うちの子にもその名前をつけていたかもしれません。

key: TAKA: Your... newborn?
en: TAKA: Your... newborn?
ja: タカ: あなたの……赤ちゃん?

key: TAUBE: Ah, right-- Yes, that's why I was leaving.
en: TAUBE: Ah, right-- Yes, that's why I was leaving.
ja: タウベ: ああ、そうでした――ええ、だから帰ろうとしていたんです。

key: I just came by to get my things; my son was born yesterday.
en: I just came by to get my things; my son was born yesterday.
ja: 物を取りに寄っただけで、息子が昨日生まれたばかりなんです。

key: So of course I'll need to be away from the temple for a while.
en: So of course I'll need to be away from the temple for a while.
ja: ですから当然、しばらく神殿を離れる必要があるんですよ。

key: It is truly a joyous occasion, being blessed with a new life in the world.
en: It is truly a joyous occasion, being blessed with a new life in the world.
ja: この世に新しい命を授かるというのは、本当に喜ばしいことです。

key: But enough about me.
en: But enough about me.
ja: でも、私の話はこれくらいにしましょう。

key: A Legendary Pokémon has traveled through time for my aid; I can of course take the time needed to tend to it.
en: A Legendary Pokémon has traveled through time for my aid; I can of course take the time needed to tend to it.
ja: 伝説のポケモンが、私の助けを求めて時を超えてきたのです。もちろん、世話をするための時間は取りますよ。

key: Come here, little one-- permit me to take a closer look at you.
en: Come here, little one-- permit me to take a closer look at you.
ja: こちらへ、小さいお友達――もっと近くで見せてくださいね。

key: TAUBE: Have you tried giving it water?
en: TAUBE: Have you tried giving it water?
ja: タウベ: 水を飲ませてみましたか?

key: TAUBE: Apologies, a little joke-- you clearly have.
en: TAUBE: Apologies, a little joke-- you clearly have.
ja: タウベ: 失礼、ちょっとした冗談です――もう試してますよね。

key: Twice, by the looks of it.
en: Twice, by the looks of it.
ja: 見たところ、二回も。

key: This Celebi is... not all here.
en: This Celebi is... not all here.
ja: このセレビィは……ここに全部がそろっていないようですね。

key: It appears like it was somehow injured while traveling through time.
en: It appears like it was somehow injured while traveling through time.
ja: どうやら、時を旅する途中で怪我をしたようです。

key: In the process, fragments of its being were scattered throughout the timeline.
en: In the process, fragments of its being were scattered throughout the timeline.
ja: その過程で、存在の欠片が時間軸のあちこちに散らばってしまったのでしょう。

key: The only way I can think of to fix this is the Relic Stone.
en: The only way I can think of to fix this is the Relic Stone.
ja: これを直す方法として、私が思いつくのはレリックストーンだけです。

key: A powerful artifact, tied closely to Celebi...
en: A powerful artifact, tied closely to Celebi...
ja: セレビィと深く結びついた、強力な秘宝で……

key: ...Unfortunately, that's all the way in the Orre region.
en: ...Unfortunately, that's all the way in the Orre region.
ja: ……残念ながら、それはオーレ地方にありまして。

key: Not an easy trip even if you're not in an unfamiliar time period.
en: Not an easy trip even if you're not in an unfamiliar time period.
ja: 慣れない時代でなくても、簡単な旅ではありません。

key: The Relic Stone would call all the fragments of Celebi into one place.
en: The Relic Stone would call all the fragments of Celebi into one place.
ja: レリックストーンなら、セレビィの欠片を全て一箇所に呼び寄せられるでしょう。

key: However...
en: However...
ja: しかし……

key: I think I can be of some help.
en: I think I can be of some help.
ja: 私にも、いくらかお力になれると思います。

key: I have a garden downstairs-- mostly just to grow food for those who need it.
en: I have a garden downstairs-- mostly just to grow food for those who need it.
ja: 下に庭があります――主に、困っている人のための食料を育てるためのものですが。

key: But it is a holy place, touched by Arceus.
en: But it is a holy place, touched by Arceus.
ja: でも、アルセウス様に触れられた神聖な場所でもあるのです。

key: The fruit always grows well, and is delicious.
en: The fruit always grows well, and is delicious.
ja: 果物はいつもよく育ち、美味しいですよ。

key: And it is... serene.
en: And it is... serene.
ja: それに……とても静かで穏やかです。

key: Perfect for meditating.
en: Perfect for meditating.
ja: めい想には打ってつけです。

key: I suspect a location like that would be very appealing to Celebi.
en: I suspect a location like that would be very appealing to Celebi.
ja: あのような場所は、セレビィにとってとても魅力的だと思うのです。

key: If this one spends some time down there, it should be able to attract at least some of the fragments.
en: If this one spends some time down there, it should be able to attract at least some of the fragments.
ja: この子があそこで少し時間を過ごせば、少なくともいくつかの欠片は引き寄せられるはずです。

key: It won't fully heal it, but it should get it in much better shape.
en: It won't fully heal it, but it should get it in much better shape.
ja: 完全には癒えないでしょうが、ずっと良い状態にはなるはずです。

key: It should at least be strong enough to get you back home.
en: It should at least be strong enough to get you back home.
ja: 少なくとも、あなた方を家まで連れ帰れるくらいの力にはなるでしょう。

key: I apologize I can't offer more.
en: I apologize I can't offer more.
ja: これ以上のことができず、申し訳ありません。

key: TAKA: No that's...
en: TAKA: No that's...
ja: タカ: いや、それは……

key: I mean, thanks.
en: I mean, thanks.
ja: その、ありがとう。

key: This is still very helpful, sir.
en: This is still very helpful, sir.
ja: それでも、とても助かるよ。

key: So do we like... just sit with Celebi under some trees, or...?
en: So do we like... just sit with Celebi under some trees, or...?
ja: じゃあ、その……木の下でセレビィと一緒に座ってればいいのかな、それとも……?

key: TAUBE: Ah, well it would probably be easier to attract the fragments if it is meditating on its own.
en: TAUBE: Ah, well it would probably be easier to attract the fragments if it is meditating on its own.
ja: タウベ: ああ、おそらく、一人でめい想させた方が欠片を引き寄せやすいでしょう。

key: TAKA: Oh, right. I guess we can like... read some books while we wait?
en: TAKA: Oh, right. I guess we can like... read some books while we wait?
ja: タカ: ああ、なるほど。じゃあ、待ってる間、本でも読んでようかな?

key: Uh, take care, Celebi.
en: Uh, take care, Celebi.
ja: えっと、気をつけてね、セレビィ。

key: Come back upstairs if you need anything.
en: Come back upstairs if you need anything.
ja: 何かあったら、上に戻ってきてね。

key: And don't leave without us! People will miss \PN back in the present!
en: And don't leave without us! People will miss \PN back in the present!
ja: それと、僕たちを置いていかないでよ! 現代で\PNがいなくなったら、みんな寂しがるからね!

key: CELEBI: Biiiii~
en: CELEBI: Biiiii~
ja: ビイイィ~

key: TAUBE: Taka, I'm sure people would miss you just as much.
en: TAUBE: Taka, I'm sure people would miss you just as much.
ja: タウベ: タカ、あなたのことも、きっと同じくらいみんな恋しがると思いますよ。

key: You both seem very kind, traveling through time to help a Pokémon.
en: You both seem very kind, traveling through time to help a Pokémon.
ja: お二人とも、ポケモンを助けるために時を旅するなんて、とても優しい方たちですね。

key: But of course, I do not expect you to sit around reading and discussing theology while you wait-- though you are welcome to, if you would enjoy that.
en: But of course, I do not expect you to sit around reading and discussing theology while you wait-- though you are welcome to, if you would enjoy that.
ja: もちろん、待っている間ずっと本を読んで神学の議論をしていてほしいわけではありませんよ――お望みなら、それも大歓迎ですが。

key: I notice you both appear to be Pokémon Trainers.
en: I notice you both appear to be Pokémon Trainers.
ja: お二人とも、ポケモントレーナーのようですね。

key: I must admit I don't find much time to battle, but...
en: I must admit I don't find much time to battle, but...
ja: 正直、バトルの時間はなかなか取れないのですが……

key: Well, with my son just born, this might be the last chance I have to battle for a while; I'll be so busy!
en: Well, with my son just born, this might be the last chance I have to battle for a while; I'll be so busy!
ja: まあ、息子が生まれたばかりですし、これがしばらくの間、バトルできる最後の機会かもしれません。忙しくなりますからね!

key: TAKA: Ah, well... I'm pretty rusty, to be honest.
en: TAKA: Ah, well... I'm pretty rusty, to be honest.
ja: タカ: あ、その……正直、僕はだいぶ腕が鈍っててさ。

key: But not \PN! He's the Champion!
en: But not \PN! He's the Champion!
ja: でも\PNは違うよ! 彼はチャンピオンなんだ!

key: But not \PN! She's the Champion!
en: But not \PN! She's the Champion!
ja: でも\PNは違うよ! 彼女はチャンピオンなんだ!

key: But not \PN! They're the Champion!
en: But not \PN! They're the Champion!
ja: でも\PNは違うよ! この人はチャンピオンなんだ!

key: TAUBE: The Champion, you say?
en: TAUBE: The Champion, you say?
ja: タウベ: チャンピオン、ですか?

key: From another region, or do we get a League in the future?
en: From another region, or do we get a League in the future?
ja: 別の地方から来られたのか、それともこの先、私たちの地方にもリーグができるのか?

key: You know, don't answer that. I probably shouldn't know.
en: You know, don't answer that. I probably shouldn't know.
ja: いえ、答えなくていいです。私が知るべきことではないでしょうから。

key: I doubt a humble man of the cloth will be much of a challenge for a Champion of any region...
en: I doubt a humble man of the cloth will be much of a challenge for a Champion of any region...
ja: どの地方のチャンピオンにとっても、しがない聖職者が大した相手になるとは思えませんが……

key: But I hope I can at least help pass the time while you wait.
en: But I hope I can at least help pass the time while you wait.
ja: でも、待っている間の時間つぶしくらいには、お役に立てるといいですね。

key: No pressure, of course. Feel free to look around, but speak to me if you feel like a battle, \PN!
en: No pressure, of course. Feel free to look around, but speak to me if you feel like a battle, \PN!
ja: もちろん、無理にとは言いません。自由に見て回ってくださいね、でもバトルしたい気分になったら声をかけてください、\PN!

key: TAKA: So Father was born... yesterday?
en: TAKA: So Father was born... yesterday?
ja: タカ: つまり父さんは……昨日生まれたばかり?

key: And Grandfather seems... nice?
en: And Grandfather seems... nice?
ja: それでおじいちゃんは……優しい人、みたいな?

key: This is a lot to take in.
en: This is a lot to take in.
ja: 受け止めるには、色々ありすぎるよ。

key: Honestly, watching a battle might take my mind off of how weird this all is.
en: Honestly, watching a battle might take my mind off of how weird this all is.
ja: 正直、バトルを見てる方が、この状況の奇妙さを忘れられるかも。

key: I apologize, my Lord;
en: I apologize, my Lord;
ja: おわびいたします、我が主よ。

key: This temple holds a lot of memories for me.
en: This temple holds a lot of memories for me.
ja: この神殿には、私にとって多くの思い出があるのです。

key: I was briefly overwhelmed.
en: I was briefly overwhelmed.
ja: 一瞬、感情が高ぶってしまいました。

key: When I was a child, I would often visit Phoe--
en: When I was a child, I would often visit Phoe--
ja: 子供の頃、よくフェニ――のところへ通っていました――

key: ELIAS: Ah, the task at hand. Of course.
en: ELIAS: Ah, the task at hand. Of course.
ja: イライアス: ああ、目の前の用件でしたね。もちろんです。

key: Father Taube is an incredibly important and busy man, but he will surely aid us with Celebi.
en: Father Taube is an incredibly important and busy man, but he will surely aid us with Celebi.
ja: タウベ神父は非常に重要で多忙な方ですが、きっとセレビィのことで力を貸してくださるでしょう。

key: Also I kindly request you do not mention my name.
en: Also I kindly request you do not mention my name.
ja: それと、どうか私の名前は口にしないようお願いします。

key: It may be complicated if he figures out who I am.
en: It may be complicated if he figures out who I am.
ja: 私が何者か気づかれると、事が複雑になりかねませんので。

key: ELIAS: Aquila non capit muscas.
en: ELIAS: Aquila non capit muscas.
ja: イライアス: Aquila non capit muscas.

key: We understand you are incredibly busy, and would not bother you if we were not in the utmost need of aid.
en: We understand you are incredibly busy, and would not bother you if we were not in the utmost need of aid.
ja: あなたが非常にお忙しいことは承知しております。この上ない助けが必要でなければ、お邪魔することはございません。

key: Tempus rerum imperator.
en: Tempus rerum imperator.

key: ???: Time waits for no man.
en: ???: Time waits for no man.
ja: ???: 時は誰も待たない、ですね。

key: You are very well versed in the ancient tongue.
en: You are very well versed in the ancient tongue.
ja: 古語に大変お詳しいようですね。

key: Judging by your garb, you are also of our Order?
en: Judging by your garb, you are also of our Order?
ja: その装いから察するに、あなたも私たちの教団の方でしょうか?

key: It is of no matter-- I truly am in a hurry, but if this is as urgent as you say, I will do what I can.
en: It is of no matter-- I truly am in a hurry, but if this is as urgent as you say, I will do what I can.
ja: それはともかく――本当に急いでいるのですが、おっしゃる通り緊急なら、できることをしましょう。
私は……

key: Oh my.
en: Oh my.
ja: おやおや。

key: I see what you meant about time.
en: I see what you meant about time.
ja: 「時」についておっしゃっていた意味が、わかりましたよ。

key: A priest with a penchant for wordplay.
en: A priest with a penchant for wordplay.
ja: 言葉遊びがお好きな聖職者ですね。

key: ELIAS: I-- goodness no, I didn't--
en: ELIAS: I-- goodness no, I didn't--
ja: イライアス: 私は――いえ、そんなつもりでは――

key: Of course, I had no intention of making light of the presence of a Legendary Pokémon.
en: Of course, I had no intention of making light of the presence of a Legendary Pokémon.
ja: もちろん、伝説のポケモンの存在を軽んじるつもりなど毛頭ございません。

key: Mea Culpa.
en: Mea Culpa.

key: My sincerest apologies for any disrespect.
en: My sincerest apologies for any disrespect.
ja: 万が一の非礼があれば、心よりおわび申し上げます。

key: ???: Goodness, you don't need to apologize for making a joke; I enjoy a good laugh myself!
en: ???: Goodness, you don't need to apologize for making a joke; I enjoy a good laugh myself!
ja: ???: おやおや、冗談を言ったくらいで謝る必要はありませんよ、私も笑いは好きですから!

key: If anybody has been disrespectful, it is me--
en: If anybody has been disrespectful, it is me--
ja: もし非礼を働いた者がいるとすれば、それは私の方です――

key: I have yet to introduce myself!
en: I have yet to introduce myself!
ja: まだ自己紹介がまだでしたね!

key: I am Taube Alcantara.
en: I am Taube Alcantara.
ja: 私はタウベ・アルカンタラ。

key: I oversee this temple.
en: I oversee this temple.
ja: この神殿を治めております。

key: You appear to be a priest of our Order, but I do not recognize you.
en: You appear to be a priest of our Order, but I do not recognize you.
ja: あなたは私たちの教団の聖職者のようですが、見覚えがありませんね。

key: I take that to mean Celebi has brought you both from another time?
en: I take that to mean Celebi has brought you both from another time?
ja: ということは、セレビィがあなた方お二人を、別の時代からお連れしたということでしょうか?

key: ELIAS: De futuro. We are from the future.
en: ELIAS: De futuro. We are from the future.
ja: イライアス: De futuro. 私たちは未来から参りました。

key: TAUBE: I see...
en: TAUBE: I see...
ja: タウベ: なるほど……

key: You appear rather nervous about me, I can only hope that means my time leading the Order is viewed positively in the future.
en: You appear rather nervous about me, I can only hope that means my time leading the Order is viewed positively in the future.
ja: 私を前にずいぶん緊張しておられるようですが、それはつまり、未来において私が教団を率いた時代が、好意的に見られているということだと願うばかりです。

key: Be that as it may, you may be calm.
en: Be that as it may, you may be calm.
ja: いずれにせよ、どうぞ気を楽になさってください。

key: You do not need to show off your mastery of the ancient tongue to me-- I do not doubt your devotion to Arceus' teachings.
en: You do not need to show off your mastery of the ancient tongue to me-- I do not doubt your devotion to Arceus' teachings.
ja: 私に古語の腕前を見せる必要はありませんよ――アルセウス様の教えへのあなたの献身を、疑ってはおりませんから。

key: ELIAS: Oh, no, I did not mean to show off, Father Taube.
en: ELIAS: Oh, no, I did not mean to show off, Father Taube.
ja: イライアス: いえ、見せびらかすつもりなどありませんでした、タウベ神父。

key: I assure you, this is how I regularly speak.
en: I assure you, this is how I regularly speak.
ja: 誓って申し上げますが、これが私の普段の話し方なのです。

key: TAUBE: Really?
en: TAUBE: Really?
ja: タウベ: 本当ですか?

key: What of those that are not of the Order, who do not know the ancient tongue?
en: What of those that are not of the Order, who do not know the ancient tongue?
ja: では、教団に属さず、古語を知らない者たちにはどうなさるのですか?

key: It is our duty to aid and support all people of the region, including them.
en: It is our duty to aid and support all people of the region, including them.
ja: 彼らを含め、この地方の全ての人々を助け、支えることこそ、私たちの務めですのに。

key: I'm surprised you don't find that difficult if you risk alienating them by regularly speaking words they don't understand.
en: I'm surprised you don't find that difficult if you risk alienating them by regularly speaking words they don't understand.
ja: 彼らが理解できない言葉を使い続けて疎まれる危険を冒しても平気だとは、驚きです。

key: TAUBE: But there go my manners again!
en: TAUBE: But there go my manners again!
ja: タウベ: おっと、また行儀作法を忘れてしまいましたね!

key: Welcome to my temple, guests from the future.
en: Welcome to my temple, guests from the future.
ja: 未来からの客人よ、私の神殿へようこそ。

key: What are your names?
en: What are your names?
ja: お二人のお名前は?

key: ELIAS: Ah, right, of course.
en: ELIAS: Ah, right, of course.
ja: イライアス: ああ、そうでした。

key: My name is...
en: My name is...
ja: 私の名は…

key: \PN!
en: \PN!
ja: \PN!

key: And my friend here is Ar...
en: And my friend here is Ar...
ja: そしてこちらの友人は、アー…

key: Arcy...
en: Arcy...
ja: アーシー…

key: Arc!
en: Arc!
ja: アーク!

key: This is Arc.
en: This is Arc.
ja: こちらはアークです。

key: TAUBE: \PN and Arc? It is lovely to meet you both.
en: TAUBE: \PN and Arc? It is lovely to meet you both.
ja: タウベ: \PNとアーク? お二人にお会いできて光栄です。

key: I hope your journey through time was not arduous.
en: I hope your journey through time was not arduous.
ja: 時を超える旅が苦難のないものであったことを願います。

key: Solaris.
en: Solaris.
ja: ソラリス。

key: Solaris Brown.
en: Solaris Brown.
ja: ソラリス・ブラウン。

key: And my companion here is called \PN.
en: And my companion here is called \PN.
ja: そしてこちらの連れは\PNと申します。

key: TAUBE: Solaris and \PN? It is lovely to meet you both.
en: TAUBE: Solaris and \PN? It is lovely to meet you both.
ja: タウベ: ソラリスと\PN? お二人にお会いできて光栄です。

key: Now, no matter how much of a rush I am in to get home, I must see to my duties.
en: Now, no matter how much of a rush I am in to get home, I must see to my duties.
ja: さて、家に戻るのがどれほど急ぎであっても、私は務めを果たさねばなりません。

key: A Legendary Pokémon has traveled through time for my aid; it is only right to do everything I can to help.
en: A Legendary Pokémon has traveled through time for my aid; it is only right to do everything I can to help.
ja: 伝説のポケモンが私の助けを求めて時を渡ってきたのです。できる限りの手を尽くすのが道理というものでしょう。

key: ELIAS: My apologies again...
en: ELIAS: My apologies again...
ja: イライアス: 重ねておわび申し上げます…

key: I panicked and just said the first name that came to mind.
en: I panicked and just said the first name that came to mind.
ja: 動転して、真っ先に思いついた名を口にしてしまいました。

key: Please forgive this lie, my Lord.
en: Please forgive this lie, my Lord.
ja: この偽りをどうかお許しください、我が主。

key: ELIAS: The Relic Stone...
en: ELIAS: The Relic Stone...
ja: イライアス: 遺跡の石…

key: Unfortunately, it is similarly inaccessible in our time.
en: Unfortunately, it is similarly inaccessible in our time.
ja: 残念ながら、我々の時代でも同様に手が届かぬものです。

key: However, we possessed no alternative, so I am overjoyed to hear you have one.
en: However, we possessed no alternative, so I am overjoyed to hear you have one.
ja: しかし他に手立てもなく、あなた方がお持ちだと聞いて心からうれしく思います。

key: I presume this will be most effective if Celebi meditates on its own for a time?
en: I presume this will be most effective if Celebi meditates on its own for a time?
ja: セレビィがしばらく一人でめい想するのが、最も効果的だと思われますが?

key: TAUBE: Exactly, yes.
en: TAUBE: Exactly, yes.
ja: タウベ: ええ、その通りです。

key: I apologize for the wait.
en: I apologize for the wait.
ja: お待たせして申し訳ありません。

key: Like you no doubt are, I am quite eager to get home.
en: Like you no doubt are, I am quite eager to get home.
ja: あなた方と同じく、私も早く家に帰りたい気持ちで一杯です。

key: But it is important to see this through; Celebi came here for our aid.
en: But it is important to see this through; Celebi came here for our aid.
ja: しかし、これを最後までやり遂げることが大切です。セレビィは我々の助けを求めてここへ来たのですから。

key: ELIAS: It is no burden to wait for us.
en: ELIAS: It is no burden to wait for us.
ja: イライアス: 待つことは、我々にとって何の苦でもありません。

key: I would be honored to read some of the texts you have here, in case there are some the Order was unable to preserve?
en: I would be honored to read some of the texts you have here, in case there are some the Order was unable to preserve?
ja: よろしければ、こちらにある書物を拝読させていただければ光栄です。教団が保存できなかったものがあるかもしれませんので。

key: TAUBE: By all means, you are welcome to read whatever you wish.
en: TAUBE: By all means, you are welcome to read whatever you wish.
ja: タウベ: もちろんです、お好きなだけお読みください。

key: Ah, and the entrance is just back there, Celebi. I hope you find it peaceful.
en: Ah, and the entrance is just back there, Celebi. I hope you find it peaceful.
ja: ああ、入り口はすぐそこですよ、セレビィ。心安らかに過ごせるといいのですが。

key: TAUBE: However, while you are of course free to look through my texts...
en: TAUBE: However, while you are of course free to look through my texts...
ja: タウベ: ですが、書物をご自由にご覧いただいて構わないのですが…

key: I must admit, I couldn't help but notice you both have Pokémon on you.
en: I must admit, I couldn't help but notice you both have Pokémon on you.
ja: 正直なところ、お二人ともポケモンをお持ちだと気づかずにはいられませんでした。

key: Between my responsibilities with the Order and the changes at home, the only person I can ever find the time to battle is Joseph.
en: Between my responsibilities with the Order and the changes at home, the only person I can ever find the time to battle is Joseph.
ja: 教団の務めと家庭の変化に追われて、バトルの時間を割ける相手といえばジョセフくらいのものでして。

key: Who, naturally, I'm no match for.
en: Who, naturally, I'm no match for.
ja: もちろん、彼には全く歯が立ちません。

key: How can a humble priest compete with a man that traveled to Orre to conquer Mt. Battle?
en: How can a humble priest compete with a man that traveled to Orre to conquer Mt. Battle?
ja: オーレ地方まで渡りバトルマウンテンを制覇した男に、ただの神父が敵うはずもありません。

key: And given we have time to kill... Would one of you two care for a battle?
en: And given we have time to kill... Would one of you two care for a battle?
ja: それに、時間もありますし…お二人のどちらか、バトルはいかがですか?

key: ELIAS: Joseph... Hazel?
en: ELIAS: Joseph... Hazel?
ja: イライアス: ジョセフ…ヘイゼル?

key: I have heard the name.
en: I have heard the name.
ja: その名は耳にしたことがあります。

key: Your servant, if I recall correctly?
en: Your servant, if I recall correctly?
ja: 確か、あなたの従者でしたね?

key: TAUBE: Ah, I see you've been studying Order doctrine.
en: TAUBE: Ah, I see you've been studying Order doctrine.
ja: タウベ: ああ、教団の教義を学ばれているようですね。

key: Yes, I suppose the traditions dictate he is my servant.
en: Yes, I suppose the traditions dictate he is my servant.
ja: ええ、しきたりの上では彼は私の従者ということになりますね。

key: But, even if he is too proud to admit it, as far as I'm concerned, he's nothing short of my closest friend.
en: But, even if he is too proud to admit it, as far as I'm concerned, he's nothing short of my closest friend.
ja: しかし、彼は誇り高くて認めたがりませんが、私にとっては誰よりも近しい友人にほかなりません。

key: Interesting, I see.
en: Interesting, I see.
ja: それは興味深いですね。

key: TAUBE: I'm sure my newborn and his young Elias will get along just as well, too.
en: TAUBE: I'm sure my newborn and his young Elias will get along just as well, too.
ja: タウベ: 私の生まれたばかりの子と、彼のところの幼いイライアスも、きっと同じように仲良くなるでしょう。

key: As I said, do either of you wish to battle?
en: As I said, do either of you wish to battle?
ja: さて、先ほども言いましたが、どちらかバトルはいかがです?

key: ELIAS: Newborn...?
en: ELIAS: Newborn...?
ja: イライアス: 生まれたばかりの子…?

key: Ah, congratulations...
en: Ah, congratulations...
ja: ああ、おめでとうございます…

key: I apologize; I do not quite feel up to battling at this particular moment...
en: I apologize; I do not quite feel up to battling at this particular moment...
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、今はあまりバトルをする気分になれず…

key: But Arc is a far better trainer than I, anyway.
en: But Arc is a far better trainer than I, anyway.
ja: ですが、アークは私よりずっと優れたトレーナーです。

key: He has bested me, and serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
en: He has bested me, and serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
ja: 彼は私を打ち負かし、教団にとって一種のチャンピオンのような存在です。

key: She has bested me, and serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
en: She has bested me, and serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
ja: 彼女は私を打ち負かし、教団にとって一種のチャンピオンのような存在です。

key: They have bested me, and serve as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
en: They have bested me, and serve as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
ja: 彼らは私を打ち負かし、教団にとって一種のチャンピオンのような存在です。

key: But \PN has beaten me once before, and would make the better challenge.
en: But \PN has beaten me once before, and would make the better challenge.
ja: ですが\PNは以前にも私を倒したことがあり、より良い相手となるでしょう。

key: He serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
en: He serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
ja: 彼は教団にとって一種のチャンピオンのような存在です。

key: She serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
en: She serves as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
ja: 彼女は教団にとって一種のチャンピオンのような存在です。

key: They serve as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
en: They serve as a Champion of sorts for the Order.
ja: 彼らは教団にとって一種のチャンピオンのような存在です。

key: TAUBE: A Champion of sorts?
en: TAUBE: A Champion of sorts?
ja: タウベ: 一種のチャンピオン、ですか?

key: I hope in the future the Order does not have a need for somebody to defend us as such.
en: I hope in the future the Order does not have a need for somebody to defend us as such.
ja: 未来では、教団を守るためにそのような者を必要としない世であってほしいものです。

key: But it is nice to know we have talented trainers on our side, nonetheless.
en: But it is nice to know we have talented trainers on our side, nonetheless.
ja: とはいえ、我々の側にも優れたトレーナーがいると知れてうれしく思います。

key: You are free to look around, of course,
en: You are free to look around, of course,
ja: もちろん、自由に見て回っていただいて構いません。

key: But speak to me when you wish to battle, Champion of the Future.
en: But speak to me when you wish to battle, Champion of the Future.
ja: ですが、バトルをご希望の際はお声がけください、未来のチャンピオン殿。

key: ELIAS: ...Newborn.
en: ELIAS: ...Newborn.
ja: イライアス: …生まれたばかりの子。

key: So he was just born...
en: So he was just born...
ja: つまり、生まれたばかりだったのか…

key: And I am still a child, still without sight.
en: And I am still a child, still without sight.
ja: そして私はまだ子供で、まだ目も見えない。

key: Taube and my father were... friends?
en: Taube and my father were... friends?
ja: タウベ神父と父は…友人だったのか?

key: Pardon me; I have been given much to consider.
en: Pardon me; I have been given much to consider.
ja: 失礼しました。考えることがたくさんできてしまって。

key: It's a book where visitors to the temple can write their thoughts.
en: It's a book where visitors to the temple can write their thoughts.
ja: 神殿を訪れた人が感想を書き込める本だ。

key: It's page after page of people thanking Taube for his hard work for the people and Pokémon of the region.
en: It's page after page of people thanking Taube for his hard work for the people and Pokémon of the region.
ja: ページをめくるたびに、この地方の人々やポケモンのために尽力したタウベへの感謝の言葉が並んでいる。

key: There's a small note scribbled on the very last page.
en: There's a small note scribbled on the very last page.
ja: 最後のページに、小さなメモが走り書きされている。

key: "I'm really glad I met you."
en: "I'm really glad I met you."
ja: 「あなたに出会えて、本当によかった」

key: It's Taka's handwriting.
en: It's Taka's handwriting.
ja: タカの筆跡だ。

key: TAUBE: The poor Pokémon...
en: TAUBE: The poor Pokémon...
ja: タウベ: かわいそうなポケモンだ…

key: But I have every faith you can bring it back to its senses.
en: But I have every faith you can bring it back to its senses.
ja: しかし、あなたならきっとこの子を正気に戻せると信じています。

key: TAUBE: Ah, hello again, Champion of the Future.
en: TAUBE: Ah, hello again, Champion of the Future.
ja: タウベ: ああ、またお会いしましたね、未来のチャンピオン殿。

key: I have good news and bad news.
en: I have good news and bad news.
ja: 良い知らせと悪い知らせがあります。

key: The good news is Celebi was able to attract a number of its Temporal Fragments.
en: The good news is Celebi was able to attract a number of its Temporal Fragments.
ja: 良い知らせは、セレビィが自分の時の欠片をいくつか引き寄せられたことです。

key: The bad news is, those fragments appear to not be too friendly.
en: The bad news is, those fragments appear to not be too friendly.
ja: 悪い知らせは、その欠片たちがあまり友好的ではなさそうなことです。

key: That poor Pokémon looks like it's about to go on a rampage!
en: That poor Pokémon looks like it's about to go on a rampage!
ja: かわいそうに、あのポケモンは今にも暴れ出しそうです!

key: I hate to ask this of you after we just battled-- but my Pokémon are in no condition to fight.
en: I hate to ask this of you after we just battled-- but my Pokémon are in no condition to fight.
ja: 先ほどバトルしたばかりなのにお願いするのは心苦しいのですが――私のポケモンは戦える状態ではありません。

key: And a battle should tire Celebi out enough to bring it back to its senses!
en: And a battle should tire Celebi out enough to bring it back to its senses!
ja: バトルでセレビィを十分に疲れさせれば、正気を取り戻せるはずです!

key: You should have no trouble with this after that showing before though.
en: You should have no trouble with this after that showing before though.
ja: 先ほどの戦いぶりを見れば、あなたなら問題ないでしょう。

key: I'm sure Celebi believes in you too. Go on ahead.
en: I'm sure Celebi believes in you too. Go on ahead.
ja: セレビィもきっとあなたを信じています。行ってきてください。

key: TAUBE: It was my honor to meet you both.
en: TAUBE: It was my honor to meet you both.
ja: タウベ: お二人にお会いできて光栄でした。

key: May Arceus make your journey home a safe one.
en: May Arceus make your journey home a safe one.
ja: アルセウスがあなた方の帰路を守ってくれますように。

key: TAUBE: It was a pleasure to meet you both.
en: TAUBE: It was a pleasure to meet you both.
ja: タウベ: お二人にお会いできてうれしく思います。

key: TAKA: I guess we go back home after you get Celebi under control?
en: TAKA: I guess we go back home after you get Celebi under control?
ja: タカ: セレビィを落ち着かせたら、俺たちは家に帰るのかな?

key: ...It's a shame that this place was replaced by the League.
en: ...It's a shame that this place was replaced by the League.
ja: …ここがリーグに取って代わられたなんて、残念だな。

key: I wonder what happened to all these plants...
en: I wonder what happened to all these plants...
ja: この植物たち、どうなっちゃったんだろう…

key: TAKA: When he said he had a garden down here, I wasn't expecting a full orchard!
en: TAKA: When he said he had a garden down here, I wasn't expecting a full orchard!
ja: タカ: ここに庭があるって聞いてたけど、まさか本格的な果樹園だったとはな!

key: There's enough fruit on these trees to feed like, a whole city.
en: There's enough fruit on these trees to feed like, a whole city.
ja: この木の実だけで、街ひとつ養えそうな量だ。

key: I guess everyone in my family has done great things but me...
en: I guess everyone in my family has done great things but me...
ja: 俺の家族はみんなすごいことを成し遂げてるのに、俺だけ何も…

key: ELIAS: My Lord; I know you can bring this poor Pokémon's mind back to peace.
en: ELIAS: My Lord; I know you can bring this poor Pokémon's mind back to peace.
ja: イライアス: 我が主、あなたならこのかわいそうなポケモンの心を、きっと安らかに戻せるはずです。

key: I know you would not allow a creature to suffer for a moment longer than is necessary.
en: I know you would not allow a creature to suffer for a moment longer than is necessary.
ja: あなたが、必要以上に一瞬たりとも生き物を苦しめたままにするはずがないと知っています。

key: ELIAS: I had always remembered this place as the most beautiful garden in the world.
en: ELIAS: I had always remembered this place as the most beautiful garden in the world.
ja: イライアス: 私はずっと、ここを世界で最も美しい庭だと記憶していました。

key: I admit, part of me assumed that was just the nostalgia of having spent much time here as a child.
en: I admit, part of me assumed that was just the nostalgia of having spent much time here as a child.
ja: 正直なところ、それは子供の頃ここで多くの時間を過ごした郷愁に過ぎないのだろうと、心のどこかで思っていました。

key: But clearly this place is just as grand as I recall.
en: But clearly this place is just as grand as I recall.
ja: しかし、この場所は記憶にある通り、確かに壮麗です。

key: TAKA: ...We should go now...
en: TAKA: ...We should go now...
ja: タカ: …そろそろ行かないとな…

key: ELIAS: Solaris was a codename; Phoenix was his real...
en: ELIAS: Solaris was a codename; Phoenix was his real...
ja: イライアス: ソラリスは偽名で、フェニックスが本名でした…

key: Ah, but of course, you know all this.
en: Ah, but of course, you know all this.
ja: ああ、いえ、もちろんご存じでしたね。

key: Anyway, Celebi can move through time, but not space.
en: Anyway, Celebi can move through time, but not space.
ja: ともかく、セレビィは時を渡れますが、空間は渡れません。

key: This garden is approximately located where the second Elite Four chamber is; thus Celebi should bring us back to our time in the third.
en: This garden is approximately located where the second Elite Four chamber is; thus Celebi should bring us back to our time in the third.
ja: この庭はおおよそ二番目の四天王の間があった場所にあたるので、セレビィは我々を三番目の間で我々の時代に戻すはずです。

key: Conveniently, that is my own.
en: Conveniently, that is my own.
ja: 都合のいいことに、それは私の間です。

key: I am ready to leave when you are, my Lord.
en: I am ready to leave when you are, my Lord.
ja: 我が主、あなたの準備が整い次第、いつでも出発できます。

key: A detailed handwritten encyclopedia of Legendary Pokémon.
en: A detailed handwritten encyclopedia of Legendary Pokémon.
ja: 伝説のポケモンについて詳しく手書きされた図鑑だ。

key: The drawings are brilliant, but the handwriting is abysmal.
en: The drawings are brilliant, but the handwriting is abysmal.
ja: 絵は素晴らしいが、字は酷いものだ。

key: It's a stack of complicated-looking religious textbooks.
en: It's a stack of complicated-looking religious textbooks.
ja: 難しそうな宗教の教本が積み重なっている。

key: In the middle of the stack appears to be a magazine of some sort?
en: In the middle of the stack appears to be a magazine of some sort?
ja: 山の真ん中に、何かの雑誌らしきものが挟まっている?

key: 'Dragon Tamer Monthly: Don't Miss Our Tell-All Interview with Joseph Hazel!'
en: 'Dragon Tamer Monthly: Don't Miss Our Tell-All Interview with Joseph Hazel!'
ja: 『月刊ドラゴンテイマー: ジョセフ・ヘイゼル暴露インタビュー、必見!』

key: ...This interview is so dull it makes the textbooks look like appealing reading.
